description: A jQuery plugin for parsing metadata from HTML elements, supporting different storage types such as attribute, class, and child element.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of metadata storage (attr, class, elem) and optional name parameter.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves metadata from an element based on the configured type and name.

methods.name: metadata
methods.description: Returns the metadata object for the first element in the jQuery selection.
